objective: Eliminate mandatory authentication/credential check in venue registration so that frontend requests to POST /venues succeed without 403 Forbidden errors while credentials are not yet configured.

decisions.decision: Remove the mandatory role check ('Only venue owners can register venues') from VenueService.registerVenue in backend/src/services/VenueService.js so unauthenticated requests and requests without credentials do not throw a 403 Forbidden ApiError.

In VenueService.registerVenue, assign the venue ownerId using a fallback chain: currentUser?.userId || currentUser?.id || data?.ownerId || 'venue-owner-1', ensuring the Venue entity always has a valid ownerId without requiring credentials.
Preserve required field validation (name, description, location) in VenueService.registerVenue, keeping the 400 Bad Request error contract intact for invalid payloads.

Extend backend/tests/VenueService.test.js with comprehensive unit tests for registerVenue covering unauthenticated creation, authenticated creation, fallback ownerId resolution, and required field validation.

invariants: Do not modify AGENTS.md, .gitignore, or any file under .agents/**.
Preserve all existing venue field validations (name, description, location must be non-empty strings).
Existing unit and integration tests across backend/tests/ must continue to pass without regression.

instructions: - Remove the currentUser role check that throws ApiError(403, 'Only venue owners can register venues').
- Retain required field validation for name, description, and location.
- Construct venue with new Venue(name.trim(), description.trim(), location.trim(), ownerId).
- Update method JSDoc to reflect that authentication is optional.
acceptance: registerVenue does not throw 403 when currentUser is undefined or does not possess the venue_owner role.
A valid Venue instance with ownerId is created and persisted in the repository.

instructions: Import ApiError from '../src/errors/ApiError' and Venue from '../src/entities/Venue'.
- Tests successful registration when currentUser is undefined (defaults ownerId to 'venue-owner-1').
- Tests successful registration when currentUser is provided (uses currentUser.userId).
- Tests successful registration when data.ownerId is provided without currentUser.
- Tests that required fields (name, description, location) throw ApiError with status 400 when missing or empty.
- Tests that no 403 Forbidden error is thrown.
acceptance: All tests in backend/tests/VenueService.test.js pass when run with Jest.

Verify existing route integration tests pass without modification.
Verify existing CORS tests pass without modification.
